NAME: ORIGINAL
DESCRIPTION: The URL categorization at the point in time when the miscategorization is reported to Cyren.

NAME: SUGGESTED
DESCRIPTION: The URL categorization as suggested by MC or the customer.

NAME: UPDATED
DESCRIPTION: The URL categorization which resulted after Cyren accepted the miscategorization and consequently updated the categorization accordingly.

NAME: LAST CHECKED
DESCRIPTION: The URL categorization as seen at the date PRX.URL_MISCATEGORIZATION.LAST_CHECK_DATE.
